snippet.title: Slumbering Woods | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Slumbering Woods is a cosy, hand-drawn adventure with nature-based puzzles, crafting, and exploration. Grow mushrooms, collect bugs, and restore a forgotten village. This new gameplay trailer gives us a glimpse into the game’s crafting and bug-catching along with updated visuals! 

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3243350/Slumbering_Woods/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
